component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.records.security
component.documentation:
The records add-on's three permissions, granted on the repository's DispositionRuns folder:
StartDisposition: starting a run, which finds the records due and holds them in it, and rejecting a run, which withdraws it. ApproveDisposition: approving or rejecting a run. A run is disposed of after two people with it have approved it, neither of them the person who started it. ExportRecordsAudit: filing an audit export, what the platform's audit holds of the documents under a folder the person may read, over a period: a strong permission, for the few records specialists a records schedule names (README, "The audit export").
Each includes Read and AddChildren, so that one grant on the folder is enough: a request is a document filed in it. Nuxeo counts Everything as holding every permission, and administrators as holding them all; the folder must block the permissions it would inherit, or the add-on refuses every request filed in it (README, "Security notes").
